steps.description: Replace Nominal -> Nominal alpha | beta with Nominal -> beta Nominal_LR1 and Nominal_LR1 -> alpha Nominal_LR1 | epsilon, for every alpha and beta.
Factor the common prefix 'Clause' from Utterance; move the remaining alternatives to Utterance_LF1, using epsilon for an empty suffix.

results.french_gloss: Je n'ai pas mangé depuis longtemps.

results.text: je suis kass je go nang
results.french_gloss: Je suis fatigué, je vais dormir.
results.rationale: Pronominal clause with an adjective, followed by a juxtaposed clause with serial verbs.

results.text: je suis back du school le sharp man
results.french_gloss: Je suis revenu de l'école ce matin.
results.rationale: Ambiguous complement, school nominal group and a marked adverb-plus-ambiguous group.

results.french_gloss: J'ai échoué, mon gars, j'ai mal.
results.rationale: Contracted auxiliary and verb, discourse marker, then a juxtaposed pronominal clause.

results.french_gloss: Elles perdent leur temps à commérer.
results.rationale: Pronominal clause with an adverb and an introduced ambiguous complement.

results.text: go au piol shoua mes kako

results.rationale: Two juxtaposed verb-initial phrases with introduced nominal complements.

results.text: pere ca me chop je suis kass
